en.headline: Hong Kong women’s épée team reach Asian Games last eight
en.dek: The team beat Thailand 45-27 in the last 16 in Nagoya on Friday and will next face Kazakhstan for a place in the semi-finals.

zh.headline: 港隊女重團體淘汰泰國 亞運闞八強
zh.dek: 陳港冰、吳海諤、佘繕妁及朱嘉望周五在名古屋以45：27擊敗泰國，十六強過關後下一場對哈薩克。

en.headline: Hang Seng slides more than 450 points by late morning
en.dek: The benchmark was down 1.83 percent at 24,308 at 11am, with the tech index also weaker, as US bond yields hit multi-year highs and mainland markets stayed shut for Mid-Autumn.

zh.headline: 恒指午前跌逾450點 科指跌近2.5%
zh.dek: 恒生指數上午11時報24308點，跌453點或1.83%；美債息創多年高位，內地股市因中秋休市。

en.headline: Very hot weather warning issued on Mid-Autumn Festival day
en.dek: The Observatory raised the warning at 11am, with very hot conditions expected today, and advised the public to watch for heat stroke while the yellow fire danger warning remains in force.

zh.headline: 中秋正日天文台發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台上午11時發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日天氣酷熱，呼籲提防中暑；黃色火災危險警告仍生效。

en.headline: Blue House lanterns stay lit through Mid-Autumn to 14 October
en.dek: More than 700 hand-painted lanterns hang around the Wan Chai cluster until mid-October, with charity stalls on the open ground through Saturday night.

zh.headline: 灣仔藍屋中秋花燈亮至10月14日 今晚續有義賣檔
zh.dek: 逾700盞街坊及插畫家手繪花燈掛滿石水渠街一帶，亮燈至10月中；中秋三晚在景星街空地設慈善攤檔。

en.headline: Hong Kong foil team reach Asian Games quarter-finals
en.dek: Ryan Choi, Cheung Ka-long, Ho Ching-him and Leung Chin-yu beat India 45-27 in the last 16 in Nagoya and next face Uzbekistan.

zh.headline: 港隊男花團體淘汰印度 亞運闖八強
zh.dek: 蔡俊彥、張家朗、何承謙及梁千雨周五上午在名古屋以45：27擊敗印度，十六強過關後下一場對烏茲別克。

en.headline: Lo says Kwong Wah A&E can cover area as QEH moves to Kai Tak
en.dek: The health chief said Queen Elizabeth Hospital services will shift in stages to Kai Tak Hospital, with Kwong Wah's rebuilt emergency department now three times larger.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：伊院服務遷啟德 廣華急症室可應付當區
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長表示伊利沙伯醫院服務將分階段遷往啟德醫院，重建後的廣華急症室面積擴大三倍，足以應付附近需求。

en.headline: Justice chief says law remains option on minors' social media
en.dek: Paul Lam said legislation to regulate how children use social media is one option under study, after the policy address ordered a task force led by his department.

zh.headline: 林定國：立法規管未成年用社交媒體仍是選項
zh.dek: 律政司司長表示，施政報告提出由律政司牽頭成立專責小組後，立法規管兒童使用社交媒體仍屬研究範圍之一。

en.headline: Official voter roll lists 4.12 million geographical electors
en.dek: The 2026 final registers published today record 4,116,965 geographical constituency electors, about 22,000 fewer than a year earlier, the Registration and Electoral Office said.

zh.headline: 正式選民登記冊發表 地方選區411萬6965人
zh.dek: 選舉事務處今日發表2026年正式選民及投票人登記冊，地方選區載有411萬6965名選民，較去年約少2.2萬人。

en.headline: Immigration relaxes Seamless e-Channel rules at HZMB port
en.dek: Hong Kong permanent residents aged 11 or above who have used the bridge port six times in 90 days can now enrol, with on-the-spot registration added at designated channels.

zh.headline: 入境處放寬港珠澳大橋無感e-道登記資格
zh.dek: 年滿11歲的香港永久性居民，只要過去90日經大橋口岸出入境六次或以上，即日起可登記；18歲或以上亦可在指定e-道即場辦理。

en.headline: Sixth direct university admission scheme opens in October
en.dek: Local Secondary Six students sitting the 2027 DSE can be nominated from 7 October, with more than 300 publicly funded programmes taking part across the eight UGC universities.

zh.headline: 第六屆學校推薦直接錄取計劃十月接受提名
zh.dek: 教育局公布，應考2027年文憑試的本地中六生可由10月7日起獲校方提名，八所教資會大學提供逾300個公幣資助學士課程。

en.headline: Chiu Hin-chun wins Hong Kong’s fourth Asian Games gold in rowing
en.dek: The veteran sculler took the men’s lightweight single sculls in 6:50.32 in Nagoya, completing a set of gold, silver and bronze across three Games.

zh.headline: 趙顯臻輕量級單人雙樺封王 港隊亞運添第四金
zh.dek: 港隊賽艇代表趙顯臻在名古屋以6分50秒32奪得男子輕量級單人雙樺金牌，三戰亞運集齊金銀銅，亦是港隊今屆第四金。

en.headline: ICAC graft complaints rise 40 percent, led by building repairs
en.dek: The graft-buster received 1,530 corruption complaints in the first eight months, with building management and maintenance reports more than doubling after the Tai Po Wang Fuk Court fire.

zh.headline: 廉署首8月貪污投訴升四成 樓宇維修舉報倍增
zh.dek: 廉政專員胡英明向立法會表示，今年首8個月接獲1530宗懸疑貪污投訴，樓宇管理及維修舉報按年升113%，與大埔宏福苑大火後公眾警覺上升有關。

en.headline: Yellow fire danger warning in force on hot Mid-Autumn day
en.dek: The Observatory issued the yellow fire danger warning at 6am and a hot-weather health advisory as the festival day turns fine, dry and warm, with a mainly cloudy night for moon-watching.

zh.headline: 中秋正日發出黃色火災危險警告 日間炎熱乾燥
zh.dek: 天文台今早6時發出黃色火災危險警告，並提醒天氣炎熱或影響健康。正日大致天晴乾燥，晚上部分時間多雲，方便賞月。

en.headline: Disgusting Food Museum opens at AIRSIDE Kai Tak from 29 September
en.dek: Sweden’s travelling exhibition of more than 80 polarising dishes from 35 countries arrives at GATE33 Gallery, complete with local scents, a tasting bar and a vomit bag for every visitor.

zh.headline: 嘔心食物博物館9月29日啟德AIRSIDE開幕
zh.dek: 瑞典巡迴展覽匯集逾80款來自35個國家的爭議美食，於啟德AIRSIDE GATE33 Gallery舉行，設本地氣味裝置、試食吧，每位入場者獲贈嘔吐袋。

en.headline: More than 3,800 eateries offer discounts for National Day
en.dek: Participating outlets include restaurants, hotels, food courts and market stalls, with deals of up to 30 per cent off and special set menus tied to the 77th anniversary.

zh.headline: 逾3800間食肆推國慶優惠 最高全單七折
zh.dek: 參與商戶包括餐廳、酒店、美食廣場及街市檔攤，優惠涵蓋全單折扣及以77周年為主題的套餐，部分活動已於本周起展開。

en.headline: AFCD detains eight unattended dogs after Yuen Long joint operation
en.dek: The five-day sweep with police followed a fatal dog attack last week. Three dogs were microchipped and one owner faces prosecution; a staff member was bitten but is stable.

zh.headline: 漁護署元朗聯合捕狗行動結束 共扣留八隻無人看管狗隻
zh.dek: 行動為期五日，因應上周一名女子疑遭狗隻襲擊身亡而展開。三隻狗隻有晶片，一名畜養人被檢控；一名前線人員被咬傷，情況穩定。

en.headline: Woman jailed 63 months for illegal pharmaceutical exports and money laundering
en.dek: Customs seized about 1.6 million controlled tablets worth an estimated HK$55 million in 2021. The District Court also ordered confiscation of roughly HK$470,000 in frozen assets.

zh.headline: 女子非法出口受管制藥劑及洗黑錢判監63個月
zh.dek: 海關2021年檢獲約160萬粒受管制藥劑製品，市值約5500萬元。區域法院另就約47萬元凍結資產作出充公申請。

en.headline: Mpox cases rise sharply; CHP urges high-risk groups to stay alert
en.dek: A new confirmed case involves a 36-year-old man in stable condition. Hong Kong has recorded 28 Mpox cases this year, 19 of them since August, mostly linked to high-risk sexual contact.

zh.headline: 猴痘個案近期大幅上升 當局籲高風險接觸者提高警覺
zh.dek: 新增一宗36歲男子確診個案，情況穩定。本港今年累計28宗，當中19宗為8月以來新增，患者多曾進行高風險性行為。

en.headline: Hong Kong waste paper to be fully pulped locally from 1 October
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department said the Tuen Mun EcoPark facility can now handle all local recovered paper, ending reliance on export and expanding accepted types to include mixed paper.

zh.headline: 回收廢紙下月起全面本地製漿 毋須再靠出口
zh.dek: 環保署表示屯門環保園紙漿設施已提升處理量，10月1日起本港回收廢紙將全面本地製漿，並擴大至雜紙類別。

en.headline: Hong Kong August exports rise 53 percent, second highest on record
en.dek: The value of total exports reached HK$667.9 billion, driven by strong demand for AI-related electronic products, while imports climbed 60 percent.

zh.headline: 本港8月出口升53% 連升30個月 進口急升60%
zh.dek: 整體出口貨值達6679億元，為有紀錄以來第二高，受人工智能相關電子產品需求帶動；進口升60%。

en.headline: Police hold major inter-departmental exercise for Interpol General Assembly
en.dek: About 3,000 personnel took part in drills at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, Victoria Harbour and West Kowloon, including a simulated biochemical attack scenario.

zh.headline: 警務處聯同多部門反恐演習 為國際刑警大會作準備
zh.dek: 約3000人參與在會展、維港及西九龍一帶的跨部門綜合演習，模擬疑似生化恐怖襲擊等情境。

en.headline: Insurance Authority fines FWD Life HK$19.5 million over AML controls
en.dek: The regulator found deficiencies in identifying third-party payers, handling potentially suspicious transactions, screening politically exposed persons and conducting customer due diligence.

zh.headline: 保監局罰富衛人壽1950萬元 涉打擊洗錢管控不足
zh.dek: 保監局實地查察後發現公司在識別第三方付款人、處理可疑交易、篩查政治人物及客戶盡職審查方面存在不足。

en.headline: Government will not appeal court ruling on Fanling golf course housing EIA
en.dek: Authorities said they decided against further appeal after reviewing legal advice on the Court of Appeal judgment that upheld the quashing of environmental approval for 12,000 public flats.

zh.headline: 政府決定不就粉嶺高球場房屋環評判決再上訴
zh.dek: 政府經考慮法律意見後決定不上訴，上訴庭早前維持原訟庭裁決，撤銷環保署對約1.2萬伙公營房屋項目環評報告的批准。

en.headline: ChinaAMC launches three Hong Kong ETFs targeting dividends, growth and cross-market…
en.dek: The funds, set to list on 30 September with HKD, RMB and USD counters, expand the firm’s range as investors seek more specialised products.

zh.headline: 華夏基金推三隻港股主題ETF 高息、增長及港美策略
zh.dek: 三隻產品定於9月30日上市，設港元、人民幣及美元櫃台，反映投資者對特定策略需求上升。

en.headline: Fong Kai-shen takes Asian Games men’s épée bronze
en.dek: The Hong Kong fencer reached the semi-finals before losing 13-15 to a Kazakh opponent, securing the medal as the event has no bronze-medal bout.

zh.headline: 方凱申亞運男子重劍個人賽奪銅
zh.dek: 港隊劍手方凱申晉身四強後不敵哈薩克對手，由於賽事不設銅牌賽，穩奪一面獎牌。

en.headline: Siobhan Haughey takes Asian Games 50m freestyle silver
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer clocked 24.32 seconds for silver behind China’s Wu Qingfeng, who set a Games record, adding a third individual medal this campaign.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓亞運女子50米自由泳摘銀
zh.dek: 港隊泳手何詩蓓以24秒32奪得銀牌，國家隊吳卿風以破亞運紀錄的23秒98奪金，這是她今屆亞運第三面個人獎牌。

en.headline: 2026 Heritage Tour focuses on Northern Metropolis historic buildings
en.dek: The Antiquities and Monuments Office’s annual programme will run from October to December with free guided tours, a travelling exhibition and stamp-collecting activities centred on sites in the northern New Territories.

zh.headline: 2026古蹟周遊樂十月展開 聚焦北都歷史建築
zh.dek: 發展局文物保育專員辦事處公布，本年度活動以「穿越北都」為主題，10月至12月舉行，提供免費導賞團、巡迴展覽及集印活動，介紹新界北部多座法定古蹟及已評級歷史建築。

en.headline: Bar staff charged after man found dead on Tsim Sha Tsui street
en.dek: A 28-year-old staff member was arrested for illegally handling a corpse after police say he and a woman moved a 48-year-old man from a bar toilet and left him on a chair outside.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧男子倒斃街頭 職員涉非法搬移屍體被捕
zh.dek: 警方凌晨接報發現48歲男子坐在河內道商廈外椅上已死，28歲酒吧職員承認與女子合力將人從廁所抬出，現被控非法搬移屍體，警方正追緝涉案女子。

en.headline: Deloitte raises Hong Kong full-year IPO forecast to at least HK$480 billion
en.dek: The firm expects about 160 listings and says the total could surpass the 2010 record of roughly HK$450 billion after a strong first three quarters.

zh.headline: 德勤上調全年港股新股融資預測至最少4800億元
zh.dek: 德勤預計全年約有160隻新股上市，融資額有望突破2010年約4500億元的歷史紀錄。

en.headline: Visitor facilitation schemes expanded to social welfare and Central Asia
en.dek: From 1 October the short-term activities scheme will cover social welfare, while the invited persons scheme will extend beyond ASEAN to Central Asia and the Middle East.

zh.headline: 短期訪客計劃增社福界 特邀人士計劃擴至中亞中東
zh.dek: 政府公布10月1日起擴展兩項入境便利計劃，短期訪客計劃新增社會福利界別，特邀人士計劃則由東盟延伸至中亞及中東國家。

en.headline: HKMA and Bank Indonesia sign MoU on QR code cross-border payments
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Indonesia agreed to explore technical, operational and regulatory arrangements for interoperable QR payments between the two places.

zh.headline: 金管局與印尼央行簽備忘錄 加強二維碼跨境支付合作
zh.dek: 香港金融管理局與印尼中央銀行今日簽署合作備忘錄，將就技術、營運及監管事宜展開對話，探討促進兩地二維碼跨境支付互聯互通。

en.headline: Light Rail rides free all day on Mid-Autumn Festival
en.dek: MTR said every Light Rail trip from first train to 11.59pm on Friday will carry no fare, covering Tuen Mun, Yuen Long and Tin Shui Wai.

zh.headline: 中秋正日輕鐵全日免費 屯元天任搭至深夜
zh.dek: 港鐵公布周五9月25日由頭班車起至晚上11時59分，進出輕鐵站無需支付車費。

en.headline: Hui says RMB government payments will not touch the peg
en.dek: The financial services chief told RTHK that using renminbi for some official spending is a matching exercise, with the Hong Kong dollar remaining the core.

zh.headline: 許正宇：人民幣付政府開支與聯匯無關
zh.dek: 財庫局長在電台節目表示，以人民幣支付部分開支是為收支場景匹配，佔比不會高，核心仍是港元。

en.headline: Hong Kong rowers take two Asian Games silvers in an hour
en.dek: Winnie Hung Wing-yan finished second in the lightweight single sculls, then Cheung Yuen-shan and Leung Ying-on won the lightweight double sculls.

zh.headline: 港隊賽艇一朝兩銀 洪詠甄與雙人艇組合齊上頒獎台
zh.dek: 洪詠甄女子輕量級單人雙樞艇先摘銀，張菌珊與梁穎桉隨後在雙人雙樞艇後上再添一銀。

en.headline: Leung Yu-hong takes historic Asian Games sanda silver
en.dek: The 21-year-old world champion lost the men's 60kg final to China's Tang Sishuo, giving Hong Kong its best Asian Games result in the discipline.

zh.headline: 梁宇航亞運散打60公斤級摘銀 港隊項目最佳
zh.dek: 21歲世界冠軍周四決賽不敵國家隊唐思碩，寫下港隊亞運散打歷來最佳成績。

en.headline: Po Pin Chau Mid-Autumn booking slots already full
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department's trial reservation for the High Island geo trail section is fully taken for 25 and 26 September, with some National Day week sessions also gone.

zh.headline: 破邊洲中秋預約已滿 國慶部分時段亦額滿
zh.dek: 漁護署萬宜地質步道破邊洲段試行實名預約，9月25及26日名額已滿，每日上限2000人。

en.headline: Sandy Ridge data cluster set for phased opening in mid-2027
en.dek: CLP Power and Range Intelligent Computing said the Northern Metropolis project would start earlier than the original 2029 target, with investment above HK$23.8 billion.

zh.headline: 沙嶺數據設施群料2027年中分期啟用
zh.dek: 中電與潤澤科技舉行啟航典禮，項目較原定2029年提前，累計投入逾238億元，首期爭取明年中啟用。

en.headline: Child abuse cases up sharply since 2020, welfare group says
en.dek: Against Child Abuse said suspected cases rose from 940 in 2020 to 1,354 in 2025, with sexual and physical abuse recorded at the same level for the first time.

zh.headline: 防止虐兒會：懸疑虐兒個案五年升至1354宗
zh.dek: 機構引述社署數字，指2025年性侵犯與身體虐待同錄501宗，二十多年來首次持平，促檢視強制舉報成效。

en.headline: Hong Kong ranks 14th in global property transparency index
en.dek: JLL's biennial survey placed the city third in Asia behind Japan and Singapore, with a composite score of 1.97 in the Transparent tier.

zh.headline: 仲量聯行：香港地產透明度全球第14 亞洲第三
zh.dek: 2026年全球地產透明度指數顯示香港綜合評分1.97，維持「具透明度」級別，亞洲僅次於日本及新加坡。

en.headline: Pok Fu Lam fire dragon parade set for Mid-Autumn night
en.dek: Villagers will carry a straw-and-bamboo dragon through Pok Fu Lam Village and Wah Fu on Friday evening, ending with the traditional return-to-the-sea rite at Waterfall Bay Park.

zh.headline: 薄扶林村中秋火龍周五夜巡遊至瀑布灣
zh.dek: 薄扶林村火龍會周五傍晚6時半至午夜在村內、華富及瀑布灣公園舞火龍，最後舉行「龍歸滄海」，免費觀賞。

en.headline: Government leans toward 10 to 12 hours of civil service family leave
en.dek: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung Ho Poi-yan said the planned hourly leave is meant for sudden family needs and that applications should be simple, with a final figure still to be set.

zh.headline: 公僕照顧家庭假傾向每年10至12小時
zh.dek: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵在立法會表示，假期旨在應付突發家事，申請程序擬從簡，確實時數仍未定案，預計明年推出。

en.headline: Man arrested after woman treated for suspected botulinum poisoning
en.dek: A 41-year-old man was held in Tsim Sha Tsui on suspicion of practising medicine illegally and possessing Part I poisons after a 35-year-old woman fell ill following a facial injection.

zh.headline: 尖沙嘴女子注射肉毒後不適 41歲男涉非法行醫被捕
zh.dek: 警方聯同衞生署在尖沙嘴拘捕一名譚姓男子，涉嫌非法行醫及管有第一部毒藥，檢獲五盒藥劑，已准保釋候查。

en.headline: Animal activist charged after microchipped dog seized in Yuen Long hunt
en.dek: Kent Luk, founder of Paws Guardian Rescue Shelter, faces allegations of failing to control a dog and keeping an expired licence after an eight-dog sweep near a fatal suspected attack.

zh.headline: 元朗捕狗行動再獲三犬 動保義工被控疎於看管
zh.dek: 漁護署聯同警方第四日行動後累計扣留八隻唐狗；毛守救援創辦人陸家捷稱其名下晶片登記犬被控沒有妥善管控及過期狗牌。

en.headline: Hong Kong expects 1.29 million mainland visitors over National Day week
en.dek: The Immigration Department forecasts more than a 5 percent rise in daily arrivals from 1 to 7 October, with 1,180 tour groups also expected, officials said after a coordination meeting.

zh.headline: 入境處料國慶黃金周約129萬內地旅客訪港
zh.dek: 當局預計10月1日至7日每日平均訪港人次較去年同期升逾5%，另有約1180個旅行團入境，政務司司長已主持跨部門會議統籌接待。

en.headline: New batch of Tung Chung public housing concrete cores all meet strength standards
en.dek: Housing Department said 36 further core samples from the affected blocks tested 26 to 83 percent above the required strength, bringing the verified share to 67 percent.

zh.headline: 東涌公屋新一批混凝土芯樣本全部達標
zh.dek: 房屋署公布再有36個芯樣強度高出標準26%至83%，累計已測67%樣本合格，餘下結果預計周五出爐。

en.headline: Mainland man arrested with five signal flares at West Kowloon station
en.dek: A 49-year-old dual-permit holder was detained after security screening found the items in his luggage; he is being held on suspicion of manufacturing or possessing explosives.

zh.headline: 西九高鐵站內地男藏五枚信號彈被捕
zh.dek: 49歲持雙程證男子下午安檢時被揭行李藏有懷疑信號彈，涉製造或管有炸藥被扣查。

en.headline: Police find no tampering in sports drinks after students fell ill
en.dek: Tests showed no foreign or toxic substances in the free bottles handed out near a Kwun Tong school athletics meet; the reported pinholes were design features of the packaging.

zh.headline: 學生飲免費運動飲品不適 警方指無發現遭人破壞
zh.dek: 東九龍總區刑事總部表示，化驗結果無異常物質，包裝上的「針孔」實為易撕線設計，冰水積聚後按壓會滲出。

en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn lantern displays extended to 4 October
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said strong visitor numbers prompted a one-week extension, with lighting hours also lengthened to midnight from 24 to 27 September.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會延至10月4日 24至27日亮燈至午夜
zh.dek: 康文署指入場人數眾多、反應熱烈，決定將展期延長一星期，並於9月24至27日將亮燈時間延至午夜12時。

en.headline: HKGAI launches AI teaching assistant HKLearn at HKUST
en.dek: The locally developed platform, powered by HKGAI V3, has drawn more than 3,000 student registrations and over 240,000 uploaded learning materials since going live.

zh.headline: 港產AI教學助理HKLearn上線 科大率先啟用
zh.dek: 由HKGAI V3驅動的平台已吸引逾3,000名學生註冊，累計上載超過24萬份學習資料。

en.headline: Housing supervisor charged over HK$500,000 illegal online football bets
en.dek: Cheung Tsz-sum, 29, a Housing Department works supervisor, appeared in Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts and was granted bail pending a further hearing on 18 November.

zh.headline: 房署監工涉非法外圍賭波約50萬元准保釋
zh.dek: 29歲一級監工張子森被控向收受賭注者投注，今日在屯門裁判法院提訊，押後至11月18日再訊，獲准保釋。

en.headline: Natalie Kan takes Asian Games 100m butterfly bronze and Hong Kong record
en.dek: The 24-year-old finished third in 58.05 seconds in Tokyo, breaking Siobhan Haughey’s previous Hong Kong mark of 58.12 set in 2023.

zh.headline: 簡綽桐亞運100米蝶泳摘銅兼破港績
zh.dek: 24歲港將周三在東京以58秒05奪銅，打破何詩蓓2023年所創58秒12的香港紀錄。

en.headline: Four stray dogs tear bumper from parked car in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Video circulating online showed a yellow dog wrenching off part of a white private car's front bumper outside Fu Shing Street before officers arrived and the animals fled.

zh.headline: 屯門四流浪狗扯斷私家車車頭泵把
zh.dek: 網上片段顯示黃狗用力拉扯白色私家車車頭泵把，另有狗隻擂上車頭；警方凌晨接報後列作流浪動物處理。

en.headline: Tsang Yee-ting takes Asian Games karate silver in -50kg kumite
en.dek: The Hong Kong fighter finished runner-up to Malaysia's Shahmalarani Chandran after a scoreless final decided by judges at Toyohashi Gymnasium on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 曾綺婷亞運空手道女子組手50公斤級奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊選手周三於豐橋市綜合體育館決賽0比0不敵馬來西亞對手，以裁判判定屈居亞軍，為港隊本屆亞運空手道第五面獎牌。

en.headline: Woman, 63, dies after concrete mixer hits pedestrian in Kam Tin
en.dek: The victim, struck on Kam Tin Road near Ko Po Tsuen at about 8.30am, was taken first to Pok Oi Hospital and later to Tuen Mun Hospital, where she was certified dead in the early afternoon.

zh.headline: 錦田公路混凝土車撞斃六旬婦 下午不治
zh.dek: 63歲女子今早約7時半在錦田公路近高埔村被運載混凝土重型貨車撞倒，先送博愛醫院再轉屯門醫院，下午約1時39分不治。

en.headline: Juvenile arrests up 20 percent in first half of 2026, police say
en.dek: Commissioner Joe Chow reported 1,580 young people aged 10 to 20 arrested from January to June, with sharp rises in serious assault and criminal damage cases linked to debt collection.

zh.headline: 上半年青少年被捕人數升兩成 警推刊物助師長預防
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴表示，今年1至6月共拘捕1580名10至20歲青少年，較去年同期升約兩成，傷人及刑事毀壞案升幅顯著。

en.headline: Lift engineer given 160 hours community service over Queen Mary defects
en.dek: Law Wing-chai, 54, was sentenced at Eastern Court for improperly issuing safety certificates and submitting misleading documents after 24 lifts in the new clinical block were found defective.

zh.headline: 瑪麗醫院升降機工程師不當發安全證書 判社服160小時
zh.dek: 羅永齊在東區裁判法院被裁定不當地發出安全證書及提交具誤導性文件罪成，判160小時社會服務令。新大樓28部升降機中有24部曾出現嚴重故障。

en.headline: Eight pupils sent to hospital after school bus hits taxi in Tin Shui Wai
en.dek: A nanny van carrying Tin Shui Wai Government Primary School pupils collided with a taxi on Tin Shui Road near Tin Chak Estate; all injuries were reported as minor.

zh.headline: 天水圍校巴與的士相撞 八學童不適送院
zh.dek: 天水圍官立小學保母車今早在天瑞路與的士輕微碰撞，八名學童其後表示不適，全部送往天水圍醫院檢查，傷勢輕微。

en.headline: Coach accused of slapping boy, 8, given three-year good behaviour bond
en.dek: Zhao Yiqun, 51, faced child abuse charges over an August 2024 incident at a Cheung Chau training camp; the Department of Justice dropped the prosecution after an agreement.

zh.headline: 教練涉掌摑8歲男童獲簽保守行為三年
zh.dek: 趙藝群被控在長洲訓練營虐待兒童及襲擊，律政司在雙方達成協議後不繼續檢控，東區裁判法院周三判簽保守行為。

en.headline: John Lee leads officials in seasonal flu vaccine drive
en.dek: The chief executive and 22 senior officials received the jab as the government rolled out four measures to boost uptake for the 2026/27 season.

zh.headline: 李家超率22名官員接種季節性流感疫苗
zh.dek: 行政長官與司局長、常秘及署長級官員一同打針，政府推出四大優化措施鼓勵市民盡早接種。

en.headline: Victoria Park lanterns stay lit through Mid-Autumn weekend
en.dek: The LCSD carnival and a first Tourism Board international display run nightly until 27 September, with lighting extended to midnight on Friday.

zh.headline: 維園綵燈會亮燈至中秋周末 正日延長至午夜
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會及旅發局首次國際綵燈匯每日傍晚6時半至11時開放，9月25日延長至午夜12時，免費入場。

en.headline: Foreign firms still backing Hong Kong, commerce chief says
en.dek: Algernon Yau told RTHK that more than 10,070 companies with overseas headquarters now have a presence here, with the United States ranking second after the mainland.

zh.headline: 丘應樺：外商對香港營商環境有信心 在港設企逾萬家
zh.dek: 商務及經濟發展局局長在港台節目表示，總部在外地而在港設立的公司已逾10070家，美國企業數目排第二。

en.headline: Siobhan Haughey defends Asian Games 100m freestyle title
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer won in 52.45 seconds in Tokyo on Tuesday, her second individual gold of the Nagoya Games after the 200m freestyle.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓亞運100米自由泳封后 兩日內個人第二金
zh.dek: 港隊「女飛魚」周二在東京水上運動中心以52秒45成功衛冕，繼周一200米自由泳後再奪金牌。

en.headline: Woman left unconscious after concrete mixer hits pedestrian in Kam Tin
en.dek: Police said a heavy vehicle carrying concrete struck a woman on a crossing along Kam Tin Road near 8.30am; she was taken to Pok Oi Hospital.

zh.headline: 錦田公路混凝土車撞女途人 傷者昏迷送博愛醫院
zh.dek: 今早約8時半，一輛運載混凝土的重型貨車在八鄉錦田公路近高埔村行人過路處撞到一名女子，司機在場助查。

en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 25,000 as financials weigh
en.dek: The benchmark was down about 186 points, or 0.7 per cent, near 24,902 in late morning trade, after opening just above the 25,000 mark.

zh.headline: 恒指失守25000點 金融股拖累早段跌約186點
zh.dek: 恒生指數公司上午10時52分數據顯示，恒指報24901點，跌186點或0.74%，早市高見25072、低見24836。

en.headline: Minister to review stray-dog feeding rules and abandonment penalties
en.dek: Environment chief Tse Chin-wan told lawmakers three of five dogs caught after the Yuen Long fatality were microchipped, and said owners cannot simply abandon animals.

zh.headline: 謝展寰：將檢視饋飼流浪狗及執法 考慮加強棄養罰則
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長在立法會簡報會表示，元朗事件後捕獲五隻狗當中三隻有晶片，反映狗主不能隨便棄養，年底前回立法會交代修例。

en.headline: Half-price National Day cinema tickets go on sale from 28 September
en.dek: The Hong Kong Theatres Association said 52 commercial cinemas will halve prices for all 1 October screenings, with tickets released from noon on Monday.

zh.headline: 國慶全線商業戲院半價 門票下周一中午起發售
zh.dek: 香港戲院商會公布，全港52間商業戲院10月1日所有場次半價，門票由9月28日中午起陸續開售，票房每人每次最多四張。

en.headline: FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026 awarded M Mark status
en.dek: The Major Sports Events Committee endorsed the four-match tournament, which opens at Mong Kok Stadium on Thursday before moving to Kai Tak.

zh.headline: FIFA東盟盃獲「M」品牌資格 周四旺角揭幕
zh.dek: 大型體育活動委員會向2026年FIFA東盟盃頒發「M」品牌資格，周四先於旺角場開賽，其後轉戰啟德體育園。

en.headline: CUHK economist denies sexism after New Asia assembly remarks
en.dek: Students complained after associate professor Terence Chong's college talk used slides on the 'cost-benefit' of women 'marrying money'; he said the language was everyday Cantonese and not discriminatory.

zh.headline: 新亞周會「釣金龜」言論惹投訴 莊太量否認歧視女性
zh.dek: 中大經濟系副教授、新亞書院副院長莊太量周二晚會上以「伴侶經濟學」作題，學生指簡報及發言帶性別定型並向校方投訴；他否認歧視，稱屬日常廣東話。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning in force until 10am for New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8.05am, saying isolated thunderstorms were expected over the New Territories this morning.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至上午10時 預料新界有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時05分發出雷暴警告，有效至上午10時，預料新界有局部地區雷暴，呼籲市民採取預防措施。

en.headline: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance returns for three Mid-Autumn nights
en.dek: The national intangible cultural heritage parade runs from 24 to 26 September, with road closures in Tai Hang and a planned stop at Victoria Park on festival night.

zh.headline: 大坑舞火龍中秋一連三晚上演 區內實施封路
zh.dek: 這項國家非遺將於9月24至26日舉行，大坑會封路改道，中秋正日火龍亦會前往維園綵燈會。

en.headline: Two more unattended dogs caught near Yuen Long attack site
en.dek: AFCD and police took two further dogs in a Tuesday night sweep around Pok Wai, the third large search in two days after a cyclist died.

zh.headline: 元朗再捕兩隻無人看管唐狗 兩日內第三度行動
zh.dek: 漁護署與警方周二晚在壤圍一帶再捕捉兩隻無人看管唐狗，屬單車女子死亡事件後兩日內第三次大型搜捕。

en.headline: Special traffic plans set for Mid-Autumn and fire dragon nights
en.dek: The Transport Department said road closures and extra public transport will run from 24 to 26 September, including overnight MTR on festival night.

zh.headline: 中秋及大坑舞火龍期間實施特別交通安排
zh.dek: 運輸署公布9月24至26日將有封路及加強公共交通服務，中秋夜大部分港鐵絲會通宵行駛。

en.headline: Government rejects EU Commission annual report on Hong Kong
en.dek: The HKSAR Government said it strongly disagreed with and opposed what it called inaccurate and biased remarks in a European Commission annual report issued with the EU High Representative.

zh.headline: 特區政府強烈不滿並反對歐盟委員會涉港年度報告
zh.dek: 特區政府就歐盟委員會及歐盟外交與安全政策高級代表發表的年度報告表示強烈不滿和反對，指內容不實及偏頓。

en.headline: Asia+ Festival opens with cross-border music fusion concert
en.dek: The fourth edition begins tonight at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre with TRI-ART! ON, pairing local artists and bands from Mongolia, Korea and Thailand.

zh.headline: 亞藝無疆開幕音樂會今晚上演 港樂人聯同蒙韓泰樂隊跨界合作
zh.dek: 第四屆亞藝無疆今晚於香港文化中心揭幕，開幕節目「三角演義」由本地音樂人聯同蒙古、韓國及泰國樂隊同台演出。

en.headline: Over 300 join counter-terrorism drill at AsiaWorld-Expo
en.dek: New Territories South police led a multi-agency exercise simulating security threats and attacks during a mock international sports conference later this year.

zh.headline: 亞博館逾300人參與跨部門反恐演習
zh.dek: 新界南總區聯同港協暨奧委會、消防處等舉行「勇箭」演習，模擬年底國際體育會議期間遇恐襲，測試協調應變。

en.headline: Supervisory committee appointed to probe Yuen Long councillor conviction
en.dek: Five-member panel will examine disciplinary action against Sei Chun-hing, who was convicted of unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under 16 and faces sentencing in October.

zh.headline: 當局委任監察委員會調查元朗區議員定罪案
zh.dek: 五人監察委員會將跟進施駿興與未滿16歲少女性交定罪案，考慮紀律處分，施已還押候10月判刑。

en.headline: Tung Chung Block 2 concrete samples fail contractual tests
en.dek: Housing Authority orders suspension of pouring and core tests after individual samples from the public housing project in Area 42 fall short of requirements.

zh.headline: 東涌第2座公屋混凝土樣本未達合約要求
zh.dek: 房委會指東涌42區公營房屋項目第2座個別混凝土樣本未達標，已即時指示承建商暫停相關位置澆灌並抽取芯樣化驗。

en.headline: Anita Mui statue returns to Avenue of Stars after restoration
en.dek: The bronze figure of the late singer was re-unveiled on Tuesday following three weeks of conservation work on the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront.

zh.headline: 梅艷芳星光大道銅像修復後重新揭幕
zh.dek: 尖沙咀星光大道銅像完成約三星期修復工程後於周二重新亮相，歌迷及圈中好友出席揭幕。

en.headline: Manpower shortfall projected at 130,000 by 2028 as AI eases demand
en.dek: Labour and Welfare Bureau mid-term update narrows earlier forecast of 180,000; clerical roles face surplus while construction, healthcare and tech remain tight.

zh.headline: 人力推算2028年短缺收窄至13萬人 AI致文書職位過剩
zh.dek: 勞福局中期更新顯示整體缺口由上次推算18萬人收窄，建造、醫療及創科仍緊張，文書支援人員料過剩2.5萬至3萬人。

en.headline: WWII British mortar fuze detonated on North Point hillside
en.dek: Police Explosive Ordnance Disposal officers destroyed the device on the slope opposite Braemar Hill Mansions at 1.18pm; no injuries and no evacuation required.

zh.headline: 北角山邊發現二戰英式迫擊砲彈引信 警方即場引爆
zh.dek: 爆炸品處理課人員下午1時18分在寶馬山道賽西湖大廈對開山邊安全引爆，無人受傷亦毋須疏散。

en.headline: Kelvin Kong appointed head of police National Security Department
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee named the long-serving officer deputy commissioner for national security, succeeding Andrew Kan who began pre-retirement leave on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 江學禮獲任命為警務處維護國家安全部門負責人
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超任命江學禮接替已開始預休的簡啟恩，任命即日生效，江學禮同日宣誓就任。

en.headline: Ryan Choi takes Asian Games men's foil silver
en.dek: The Hong Kong fencer fell 15-13 to Japan's Kazuki Iimura in the final at Tokoname, securing the city's first fencing medal of the Games after a late fightback.

zh.headline: 蔡俊彥亞運男子花劍摘銀 港隊今屆首面劍擊獎牌
zh.dek: 蔡俊彥在常滑決賽以13比15不敵日本劍手飯村一輝，逆轉後仍差一步奪金，為港隊贏得今屆亞運首面劍擊獎牌。

en.headline: Ryan Choi reaches Asian Games men's foil final
en.dek: The Hong Kong fencer advanced to the individual foil final in Tokoname, guaranteeing at least a silver medal after Cheung Ka-long exited early.

zh.headline: 蔡俊彥亞運男子花劍個人賽晉身決賽
zh.dek: 港隊劍手蔡俊彥在常滑晉級男子個人花劍決賽，鎖定至少一面銀牌，張家朗早前止步32強。

en.headline: Siobhan Haughey wins Asian Games 100m freestyle gold
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer clocked 52.45 seconds in Tokyo to take her second individual gold of the Games, less than 24 hours after defending the 200m freestyle title.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓亞運女子百米自由泳奪金
zh.dek: 何詩蓓在東京以52秒45奪得女子100米自由泳金牌，距周一衛冕200米自由泳金牌不足24小時，今屆個人第二金。

en.headline: Twelve students ill after free drinks with suspected pinholes at sports meet
en.dek: Police are investigating energy drinks handed out outside Hammer Hill Road Sports Ground during a school athletics meet after at least 12 pupils reported dizziness and stomach pain.

zh.headline: 斧山道運動場外派免費飲品疑有針孔 12學生不適
zh.dek: 黃大仙斧山道運動場外有人派發能量飲品，部分包裝懷疑有針孔，至少12名學生飲後報稱頭暈及肚痛，警方正調查。

en.headline: AFCD says every dog attack is one tragedy too many after Yuen Long death
en.dek: Assistant director Jackie Yip pledged to tackle stray dogs at source through registration, vaccination and desexing, as joint capture operations continue in the Pok Wai area.

zh.headline: 漁護署：每宗狗隻襲擊都是悲劇 將從源頭處理流浪狗
zh.dek: 助理署長葉嘉明周二表示會透過強制登記、疫苗及絕育從源頭減少流浪狗，壆圍一帶聯合捕捉行動會持續。

en.headline: Diagonal pedestrian crossing opens near Shek Mun Station in Sha Tin
en.dek: The Transport Department commissioned the junction of On Ming and On Muk streets on Tuesday, the latest of 15 planned sites expected to cut walking distance by about 30 per cent.

zh.headline: 沙田石門站對角行人過路處啟用 步行距離料減三成
zh.dek: 運輸署周二啟用安明街與安睦街交界對角過路處，行人可一次過橫過路口，屬今年15個推展地點之一。

en.headline: Chloe Leung takes Asian Games road race bronze for Hong Kong
en.dek: The cyclist finished third in the women’s individual road race in Nagoya, 41 seconds behind the leaders, after a fourth-place time-trial result two days earlier.

zh.headline: 梁穎儀亞運公路賽摘銅 港隊今屆首面單車獎牌
zh.dek: 梁穎儀在名古屋女子個人公路賽以2小時50分46秒奪銅，落後冠亞軍41秒，兩日前計時賽排第四。

en.headline: Indefinite hospital order for man who killed two women at Plaza Hollywood
en.dek: Szeto Sing-kwong pleaded guilty to manslaughter by diminished responsibility after a 2023 stabbing attack; the High Court ordered him detained without limit of time.

zh.headline: 荷里活廣場斬人案被告認誤殺 被判無限期醫院令
zh.dek: 司徒成光以減責神志失常承認兩項誤殺罪，高等法院法官杜麗冰判處無限期醫院令，形容案件為悲劇。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for southern waters and islands
en.dek: The Observatory posted the warning at 2.03pm, later extended to 4pm, as isolated storms were expected over Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and nearby waters.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料南部水域及島嶼有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 警告於下午2時03分發出，其後延長至下午4時；天文台預料香港島、九龍及附近水域有局部雷暴。

en.headline: Jewellery and cash worth HK$610,000 stolen from Repulse Bay flat
en.dek: A 52-year-old woman reported a forced window and opened jewellery boxes after returning home early on Tuesday; no arrests yet.

zh.headline: 淺水灣住宅遭爆竊 損失約61萬元珠寶現金
zh.dek: 一名52歲姓陳女子周二凌晨返家發現窗戶被撬開及多個首飾盒被翻開，報失約61萬元財物，暫無人被捕。

en.headline: LPG tanker overturns in Tsing Yi, two men injured
en.dek: The vehicle carrying about eight tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas flipped at a roundabout early on Tuesday; both occupants climbed out conscious.

zh.headline: 青衣石油氣罐車翻側 司機及乘客受傷
zh.dek: 載有約八噸石油氣的罐車周二凌晨在康宏路迴旋處失控翻側，兩人自行爬出，乘客送院治理。

en.headline: Police seize 1.55 million illicit cigarettes in Ta Kwu Ling raid
en.dek: A 33-year-old man was arrested after officers from the Tai Po anti-triad unit raided a metal warehouse in Ping Che on Monday afternoon.

zh.headline: 警方打鼓嶺搗破私煙倉 檢155萬支私煙拘一人
zh.dek: 大埔警區反三合會組周一午後在坪輋一金屬倉庫搜出約155萬支未完稅香煙，市值約700萬元，一名33歲本地男子被捕。
